parsed.name: 是德科技 EXRxx4A 四通道示波器
parsed.description: 一款台式四通道数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电压波形，可用于观察信号时域特性、触发事件及常见电学测量，适合电子电路调试、教学实验和通用实验室测试。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop 4-channel digital oscilloscope for capturing, displaying, and analyzing voltage waveforms. It is used to observe time-domain signal behavior, trigger events, and common electrical measurements in electronics debugging, teaching labs, and general laboratory testing.
